method.mean_metric_ci: nonparametric bootstrap over tasks, reps=5000, seed=1337
method.paired_binary_test: exact two-sided McNemar/binomial sign test on discordant task coverage pairs
method.multiple_comparison_adjustment: Holm-Bonferroni over the selected paired tests reported in the paper table
method.note: Statistics are recomputed from archived candidate-level CSVs when available. Some repair arms lack compile-set CSVs and therefore have no paired compile test.
